implementation_constraints: StartFindService generates a fresh search handle and stores a user callback; do not assert equal registration handles
The callback receives a FindServiceHandle identifying the operation; use this to associate asynchronous results
Keep the callable captures identical on repeated invocations; callback wrappers may remain distinct operations
The manifest declares one concrete service instance; compare the single discovered handle before/after repeat operations
Keep callback captures alive until all searches have stopped, and use a mutex for callback result access
All native configuration, production implementation, source pins and licenses remain unchanged
All five required native check commands must be retained for the new source; old passing tests do not qualify this proposal
